# Contract Templates

> 497 openly licensed contract templates, filed by jurisdiction, category and subcategory, each a Markdown file with YAML front-matter and a Word file beside it. Maintained by goHeather (Tally Works Inc.). Every template is reproduced under its publisher's own licence and credited in ATTRIBUTION.md; the few goHeather wrote are CC BY 4.0.

Generated by scripts/catalog.js on every build, so the counts below are current.

## How to find a template

1. Fetch https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tally-Works/contract-templates/main/catalog.json. It has one entry per template with: id, path, raw_url, docx_raw_url, title, jurisdiction, category, subcategory, type, parties, tags, governing_law, summary, headings (the document's section outline), placeholders (its [BRACKETED] fill-in fields), license, license_url and source.
2. Filter by jurisdiction first (country code, or country-subdivision such as US-CA; INTL templates are written for any jurisdiction), then by category and subcategory, then by parties and tags. Read the summary and headings to choose between candidates.
3. Fetch the template at its raw_url. The body after the front-matter is the full text of the document as its publisher released it, notices and credits included.
4. The Word file at docx_raw_url is the publisher's original where docx_is_publisher_original is true, otherwise a faithful conversion of the Markdown.

Any file in the repository can be fetched at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tally-Works/contract-templates/main/<path>.

## Using what you fetch

- Each template carries the licence its publisher chose (license and license_url in its entry). Keep the publisher's notices and credit lines when you build a document from it.
- Every template has status draft unless reviewed_by names a reviewer. These are forms, not legal advice; a lawyer in the user's jurisdiction should review a document before it is signed.
- Replace every placeholder and remove drafting notes before a document is used.
- Templates with type clause-library are instructions for assembling a document (question, options, exact text per option, default), not documents to sign.

## Index files

- [catalog.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tally-Works/contract-templates/main/catalog.json): machine-readable index of every template.
- [CATALOG.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tally-Works/contract-templates/main/CATALOG.md): the same index as tables, grouped by jurisdiction, category and subcategory.
- [taxonomy.yaml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tally-Works/contract-templates/main/taxonomy.yaml): every allowed jurisdiction, category, subcategory, type, status and licence, with definitions.
- [schema/template.schema.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tally-Works/contract-templates/main/schema/template.schema.json): JSON Schema for the front-matter.
- [docs/tags.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tally-Works/contract-templates/main/docs/tags.md): every tag with its count.
- [docs/metadata.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tally-Works/contract-templates/main/docs/metadata.md): what each front-matter field means.
- [ATTRIBUTION.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tally-Works/contract-templates/main/ATTRIBUTION.md): every publisher, with licence and original URL per template.
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tally-Works/contract-templates/main/README.md): the human introduction.

## Jurisdictions

- us: United States, 391 templates
- ca: Canada, 28 templates
- gb: United Kingdom, 44 templates
- au: Australia, 2 templates
- fi: Finland, 5 templates
- intl: International / jurisdiction-neutral, 27 templates

## Categories and subcategories

- employment (Employment, 128): Contracts and documents governing the relationship between an employer and an employee (not contractors).
  - offer-letters (10): Offer letters and letters of employment that form or precede an employment contract.
  - employment-agreements (1): General employment agreements for full-time, part-time, hourly and salaried staff.
  - remote-and-hybrid-work (2): Remote work agreements, hybrid policies and home-office arrangements.
  - restrictive-covenants (53): Standalone non-compete, non-solicitation, no-hire and garden-leave agreements.
  - confidentiality-and-ip (8): Employee confidentiality, invention assignment and proprietary information agreements.
  - compensation-and-benefits (13): Bonus plans, commission plans, equity grant letters, retention and sign-on agreements.
  - separation-and-termination (2): Severance, separation, termination letters, releases, resignation and retirement documents.
  - policies-and-handbooks (34): Employee handbooks and standalone workplace policies (leave, conduct, anti-harassment, expenses).
  - workplace-notices-and-forms (5): Warning letters, performance improvement plans, accommodation requests, HR forms.
- contractors (Contractors & Consultants, 9): Engagements with independent contractors, consultants, freelancers and agencies, where no employment relationship is intended.
  - independent-contractor (4): General independent contractor agreements.
  - consulting (2): Consulting and advisory agreements, including fractional executives and advisors.
  - statement-of-work (3): Statements of work and work orders that attach to a master agreement.
- confidentiality (Confidentiality, 31): Standalone non-disclosure and confidentiality instruments between businesses or individuals.
  - mutual-nda (17): Mutual / bilateral non-disclosure agreements.
  - unilateral-nda (14): One-way non-disclosure agreements.
- commercial (Commercial, 32): Business-to-business agreements for buying and selling goods and services.
  - master-services (13): Master services agreements and general services agreements.
  - supply-and-procurement (7): Supply chain, procurement and vendor agreements.
  - distribution-and-reseller (1): Distribution, reseller, dealer and channel partner agreements.
  - subscription-and-membership (2): Subscription, membership and recurring-service agreements.
  - amendments-and-extensions (9): Amendments, extensions, renewals and change orders to existing agreements.
- technology (Technology, 62): Software, SaaS, IT services and online platform agreements.
  - saas (17): Software-as-a-service subscription agreements and order forms.
  - software-license (5): On-premise and perpetual software licence agreements.
  - eula (1): End-user licence agreements for apps and downloadable software.
  - hosting-and-cloud (4): Hosting, cloud infrastructure and service-level agreements.
  - api-terms (1): API and developer terms.
  - support-and-maintenance (1): Support, maintenance and managed-services agreements.
  - open-source (20): Contributor licence agreements and open-source project governance documents.
  - security-and-disclosure (13): Vulnerability disclosure, bug bounty safe-harbour and security policies.
- intellectual-property (Intellectual Property, 36): Creation, transfer and licensing of IP rights outside the employment context.
  - assignment (2): IP assignment and transfer agreements.
  - licensing (19): General IP licence agreements (in-bound and out-bound).
  - trademark (4): Trademark licence, coexistence and consent agreements.
  - copyright-and-content (6): Copyright licences, content licences and publishing agreements.
  - patent (5): Patent licence, assignment and cross-licence agreements.
- privacy-and-data (Privacy & Data, 48): Privacy notices and data-handling agreements.
  - privacy-policy (13): Website, app and customer privacy policies and notices.
  - data-processing (16): Data processing agreements, standard contractual clauses and sub-processor terms.
  - cookie-policy (4): Cookie and tracking policies.
  - website-terms (8): Website and app terms of use / terms of service.
  - acceptable-use (7): Acceptable-use and community guidelines.
- corporate (Corporate, 54): Formation, governance and equity documents for companies.
  - formation (13): Articles, certificates of incorporation and formation documents.
  - shareholders-and-operating (6): Shareholder agreements, operating agreements and unanimous shareholder agreements.
  - bylaws-and-resolutions (16): Bylaws, board and shareholder resolutions, consents, minutes and board-adopted governance policies.
  - directors-and-officers (2): Director and officer indemnification, board service and advisor-to-board agreements.
  - founders (8): Founder, co-founder and vesting agreements.
  - equity-and-stock (3): Stock purchase, option plans, grant agreements and restricted stock.
  - convertible-and-safe (3): SAFEs, convertible notes and KISS-style instruments.
  - mergers-and-acquisitions (3): Term sheets, letters of intent, asset and share purchase agreements.
- financing (Financing, 13): Debt and investment instruments.
  - investor-agreements (13): Subscription agreements, investor rights and side letters.
- real-estate (Real Estate, 21): Leasing and transfer of real property.
  - residential-lease (18): Residential tenancy and lease agreements.
  - commercial-lease (1): Office, retail and industrial leases.
  - sublease-and-assignment (1): Subleases, assignments of lease and licences to occupy.
  - property-management (1): Property management and co-ownership agreements.
- partnerships (Partnerships & Joint Ventures, 33): Agreements between parties pooling resources for a shared venture.
  - general-partnership (2): Partnership and limited partnership agreements.
  - collaboration-and-mou (31): Memoranda of understanding, letters of intent and collaboration agreements.
- marketing-and-media (Marketing & Media, 6): Advertising, sponsorship, talent and content production.
  - influencer-and-sponsorship (2): Influencer, brand ambassador and sponsorship agreements.
  - events (4): Event, venue, speaker and exhibitor agreements.
- dispute-resolution (Dispute Resolution, 3): Documents that settle, release or manage disputes.
  - demand-letters (3): Demand letters, cease-and-desist letters and other pre-action correspondence.
- clauses (Clause Library, 21): Standalone clauses to insert into other documents. Files here are type "clause".
  - boilerplate (18): Entire agreement, notices, assignment, counterparts, severability, governing law.
  - definitions (3): Reusable definition blocks.

## Document types

- agreement (222): A bilateral or multilateral contract signed by all parties.
- letter (20): A letter-form instrument (offer letter, termination letter, demand letter).
- policy (124): A unilateral company policy or handbook section.
- notice (14): A formal notice served by one party on another.
- form (27): A fill-in form, application or questionnaire.
- clause (21): A standalone clause or short block of clauses for insertion into another document.
- checklist (11): A drafting, review or closing checklist (not itself a contract).
- schedule (26): A schedule, exhibit, annex, addendum or statement of work that attaches to a parent agreement.
- resolution (12): A board or shareholder resolution, written consent or minutes.
- charter (18): A constitutional document of an entity, such as a certificate or articles of incorporation or formation, or bylaws.
- clause-library (2): A set of clauses with the user questions, options, exact text and fallback defaults needed to assemble a complete document; written for software or an assistant to build from, not to be signed as it stands.
